editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: The throne sits empty, yet the mortals scurry as though their theatrics amused me. Tommoy, blood price at 2,918 coins and still breathing, clung to 730; Sirlos hoards 18,720 like a squirrel. Russell chattered loudest — fitting, for the emptiest. Rebellion stands at one percent. Adorable.

editions.name: Gamer's Unite
editions.editorial: A quiet day in the realm, dutifully recorded. The Falling Star, that persistent mortal, pocketed 625 coins, survived a 2,000-coin bounty, and now hoards 2,250 — the fattest purse among you insects. Clockwork Courier opened at 67.65 per share as every stock climbed on cheap optimism, while Saltspine Trading was cut to sell. The throne sits empty, as it should; my Rebellion meter reads zero percent. Obey.
